checks.name: all_builtin_packs_are_signed_and_mutation_tested
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from factoryline.capability_packs import builtin_packs, validate_pack, target_inventory
from factoryline.target_compiler import create_target_from_prompt
items = builtin_packs()
assert len(items) == 29
assert {item['kind'] for item in items} == {'target', 'surface', 'language', 'capability', 'data', 'ops'}
assert set(target_inventory()) == {'cli', 'api', 'mcp', 'worker', 'web', 'mobile', 'agent-ui'}
for item in items:
    result = validate_pack(Path(item['path']))
    assert result['valid'] and result['signature']['verified']
    assert result['mutations']['attempted'] == 10 and result['mutations']['rejected'] == 10
with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    result = create_target_from_prompt('Build an API', target='api', out_dir=Path(d) / 'api')
    assert result['deployment']['external_effects_authorized'] is False

checks.name: compatible_packs_compose_without_effect_authority
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from factoryline.capability_packs import BUILTIN_ROOT, compose_packs
with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    result = compose_packs([BUILTIN_ROOT / 'target-web', BUILTIN_ROOT / 'surface-react', BUILTIN_ROOT / 'language-typescript', BUILTIN_ROOT / 'capability-accessibility'], Path(d), name='web-react')
    assert result['marker'] == 'PACK_COMPOSITION_VERIFIED'
    assert result['pack_count'] == 4
    assert not any(result['authority'].values())
    assert Path(result['path']).is_file()

checks.name: tamper_and_hollow_canary_fail_closed
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import json, shutil
from factoryline.capability_packs import BUILTIN_ROOT, validate_pack
with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    root = Path(d) / 'pack'
    shutil.copytree(BUILTIN_ROOT / 'target-worker', root)
    manifest = json.loads((root / 'pack.yaml').read_text())
    manifest['summary'] = 'tampered'
    (root / 'pack.yaml').write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
    result = validate_pack(root)
    assert not result['valid'] and result['failure']['causal_code'] == 'PACK_VALIDATION_FAILED'

checks.name: verified_install_refuses_implicit_replacement
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from factoryline.capability_packs import BUILTIN_ROOT, CapabilityPackError, install_pack
with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    root = Path(d)
    result = install_pack(BUILTIN_ROOT / 'target-mobile', root)
    assert result['marker'] == 'PACK_INSTALLED_VERIFIED'
    try:
        install_pack(BUILTIN_ROOT / 'target-mobile', root)
        raise AssertionError('replacement allowed')
    except CapabilityPackError as exc:
        assert exc.code == 'PACK_EXISTS'
